opening.argument: The offer ties paid entry directly to token allocations: a €5,030 tycoon package is presented as providing 60,000 tokens, while the available packages range from €100 to €5,000. The presentation then supplies an appreciation scenario, stating that 48,000 coins at 50 cents would be worth €24,000, and describes how much profit is in the program. Its compensation structure is also recruitment-based: participants can build two teams, reach people many levels below them, and receive more payment as the network grows wider. These mechanisms combine paid package purchases, projected coin appreciation, and referral-linked earnings to encourage participation, even with prediction and non-guarantee caveats accompanying the offer.
